speech._note: B-18: provider ids per role, tried in order; the phone's engine is always the last resort. Twi goes to the UG HCI Lab gateway (language.json hcilab_asr / hcilab_tts) when its token is in local.properties and its quota lasts; English stays on the phone.

planner._hedgeNote: N-15 hedge: a Groq call still unanswered after hedgeAfterMs (x1.75 at high effort) is also sent on a fresh connection with the next key; the fallback chain itself (FallbackBrain) checks the link after router.network.watchdogMs of silence instead of racing providers; fallbackHedgeMs is unused. First answer wins, the other is cancelled. 0 = off. A normal step takes 1-2 s.
planner._networkRetryNote: The cloud chain retries once after a network failure only if that failure came within this many ms (a blip); a slower one means a stalled connection and the user is told at once.

guard._note: O-14: separate free-tier quota bucket; used by J-19 (flag off until verified on device)

vision._note: N-06/P-01: camera descriptions; defaults to the Gemini brain model when absent
